title: nav lists exactly six entries, in routing order
cmd:
curl -s '{{BASE}}/activity' | python3 -c "import sys,re; h=sys.stdin.read(); nav=re.search(r'
]*>(.*?)
', h, re.S).group(1); items=[re.sub(r'\s+',' ',re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',x)).strip().split(' ')[0] for x in re.findall(r']*>(.*?)', nav, re.S)]; print(items); assert items==['Profiles','Models','Activity','Conversations','Usage','Alerts'], items"

title: no agent-infrastructure nav entries survive
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/activity' | python3 -c "import sys; h=sys.stdin.read(); bad=[n for n in ('>Skills<','>Memory<','>Cron<','>Tasks<','>Fleet<','>Setup<') if n in h]; assert not bad, bad"

title: sign out is a button, not a bare link
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/activity' | python3 -c "import sys; h=sys.stdin.read(); assert 'sb-signout' in h, 'no .sb-signout'; assert 'Sign out' in h"

title: Profiles has no tab strip (Config left)
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/profiles' | python3 -c "import sys; h=sys.stdin.read(); assert 'page-tabs' not in h, 'tab strip is back'; assert 'sources-form' not in h, 'config form is back'"
